# MR Vehicle Rental (Manoranjan Travels)

> Premium Vehicle Rental, Self-Drive & Corporate Fleet Provider in Nepal.

## Overview
- **Name:** MR Vehicle Rental (Registered under Office of Company Registrar, Tourism Office Kathmandu, Nepal Travel Vehicle Association)
- **Headquarters:** Kalopul, Kathmandu, Nepal (Geo: 27.7118° N, 85.3353° E, Postal Code: 44600)
- **Phone / WhatsApp:** +977-9702134274
- **Email:** manoranjantravels2024@gmail.com
- **Website:** https://manoranjan.com.np
- **Operating Hours:** 24/7 Available (365 days)
- **Fleet Ownership:** 100% company-owned fleet (No third-party outsourcing)

## Services Offered
- **Rent with Driver (Chauffeur Service):** Chauffeur-driven sedans, SUVs, 4WD Jeeps, Hiace tourist vans, and luxury buses for city sightseeing, airport pickups, and inter-city routes across Nepal.
- **Self-Drive Car Rental:** Driverless rental options for cars and SUVs across Nepal with flexible daily, weekly, and monthly rates. Fixed pickup location at Kalopul, Kathmandu.
- **Corporate Fleet Rental & B2B Leasing:** Long-term corporate vehicle leasing for enterprises, embassies, and NGOs with VAT-compliant invoicing, SLA uptime guarantee, and 60-minute replacement support.
- **Airport Transfers:** 24/7 private transfers to/from Tribhuvan International Airport (TIA) to Thamel, Patan, Bhaktapur, and Nagarkot.

## Vehicle Fleet & Starting Rates
- **Sedan / Hatchback (4 Seater):** NPR 5,000 / 7 (Swift Dzire, Hyundai Aura) - City Tours & Airport Transfers
- **Comfort & Premium SUV (4-5 Seater):** NPR 6,000 - 8,000 / 4 - 9 (Toyota Fortuner, Suzuki Brezza, BYD Atto 3 EV) - Highway & Family Trips
- **4WD Rugged Jeep (7 Seater):** NPR 7,000 / 2 (Mahindra Scorpio 4x4) - Upper Mustang, Manang, Muktinath off-road
- **Toyota Hiace Tourist Van (10-14 Seater):** NPR 8,000 / 9 - Small groups & pilgrimage tours
- **Toyota Coaster / Mini Bus (18-25 Seater):** NPR 11,000 / 1 - Corporate retreats & school outings
- **Sutlej / Tourist Bus (35-41 Seater):** NPR 14,000 / 04 - Large group delegations & conferences
- **Premium Fleet (4, 7, 30 Seater):** NPR 15,000 / 11 - VIP delegations & executive events

## Key Destinations Covered
- Kathmandu Valley (Patan, Bhaktapur, Nagarkot, Dhulikhel)
- Pokhara (Prithvi Highway corridor)
- Chitwan National Park & Sauraha (Wildlife safaris)
- Lumbini (Birthplace of Lord Buddha)
- Mustang & Manang (Off-road Himalayan expeditions)
- Bandipur, Gorkha, Janakpur, Rara Lake, and Langtang
